document.text:
Electric charge is a property of matter. A charge creates an electric field, and an electric field exerts a force on another charge. That force can change the charge's motion.

A moving charge, or electric current, creates a magnetic field. A changing magnetic field induces an electric field. A changing electric field induces a magnetic field.

Changing electric and magnetic fields can sustain one another and form an electromagnetic wave. Light is an electromagnetic wave.
